sequence_note: The puzzle's order (#37): the pin cleans the hole (ear -> ear-clean) and, held in, slides the middle wave aside (wave -> wave-slid: the post shows); the coin on the post (post-coin), turned (post-turned): the back's line opens into slits (back-open); the comb's teeth in the slits: the bolt can move (bolt -> bolt-out), and the lock chirps. Let go of the pin and the wave slides back (hide post-coin/post-turned/back-open with it); let go of the coin and the slits close.
